items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They used to call Pigmeat Markham Rock. You know, they used to call him Eight Rock. [INTERVIEWEE] Because that was his color.

ctx.x: No, he was about my color. He's from Memphis.
They used to call Pigmeat Markham Rock. You know, they used to call him Eight Rock.
